runs.text: After the pizza, the 23 people at the party sit down in the canteen. Each table has 4 chairs. How many tables must be set up so that nobody is left standing? The program shows only the number.

hints.text: Can the answer have decimals? What happens to the person who does not fill a table?

runs.text: The new tables have 6 chairs. How many are needed now? (Answer: 4.)
. Frequent mistake: answering 5, which leaves three people standing, or 5.75. There are no hidden cases: before reading values, the program has a single case.
